d: US President Donald Trump and his Republican party have lost the midterm elections. Democrats made unprecedented gains in the midterms, and US Vice President JD Vance says that the reason is the Iran war. Trump has admitted that the Iran war might be to blame for the midterm loss, but he says he would do it again. Firstpost looks at Trump's options now that the midterms are over. Hem Kaur Saroya examines whether the US President will restart the war on Iran, or resort to diplomacy to end the conflict. HKS also looks at the other options the US has to end the crisis in West Asia.
